parameters.colorMode: cyclic sliding four-color window, only future refills change; existing drops retain their colors

method.draws: Uniform sample without replacement: independent board-seed and draw RNG streams, actual8balls outof25
method.carry: One continuous player per run. Retain exact terminal carry after own positiveWIN; only own completed0WIN resets. No artificial resets between samples.
method.calibration: 24576games bracketed the operating curve. Two independent4096-game streams per setting validated initial knots; only50and75, whose targets fell outside the empirical block intervals, were adjusted and revalidated on two fresh4096-game streams.
method.lowBetCaution: Low-BET results are additional spot/profile observations, not exhaustive validation of everyBET/rate pair. Preliminary1/BETinterpolation was rejected after observed floor-class errors; final classes1,2/4,3,5–9use different cohesion anchors. The same-seed2048and4096low-BETprobe prefixes overlap and must not be pooled as independent evidence. Game totals count computation, not unique independent trajectories.
method.geometry: Real production staggered gravity with exact cached geometric collision paths for sampling; full states and animation timelines compared with unmodified production geometry for96games/768balls.
method.scope: Direct Six Drop role payouts and all-clear payouts. SharedSugar/JPC, external roulette bias and adaptive serverfeedback excluded.
method.uncertainty: Finite-sample block intervals are empirical diagnostics, not per-round or exact long-run payout guarantees. New rules use unchanged inherited bank; validation starts each independent continuous player with empty carry.
method.sourceProvenance: Every run records its executed full-source hash. Changes made after each main run changed comments, another target knot, or the <10BET correction only. controlsMatchFinalCore compares each observed target andBET with the final core. Legacy248/278/280/283 paths are preserved and regression-tested separately.
